en.p: In the coordinate plane, for the two points $\mathrm{A}(1,\,0)$ and $\mathrm{B}(1,\,1)$, two points $\mathrm{P}$ and $\mathrm{Q}$ satisfy

For the two points $\mathrm{P}$, $\mathrm{Q}$ that minimize the value of $\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{PQ}}\right|$, what is the value of $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{AP}}\cdot\overrightarrow{\mathrm{BQ}}$? (Here $\mathrm{O}$ is the origin, and $\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{AP}}\right|>0$.) [4 points]
